# The CS Quarterly

> A weekly dispatch and content hub for Customer Success leaders and managers. Curated essays on stakeholder management, escalation, negotiation, sales qualification, and AI deployment, plus the CS Operating Maturity Diagnostic and the CSFactors operating cockpit.

The CS Quarterly publishes one essay per Tuesday aimed at VPs, Directors, and Senior CSMs at SaaS companies between $20M and $1B ARR. The audience is operators running revenue retention, not generalist marketing readers. Every premium essay is published in two parallel voices — analytical and witty — toggled inline. Articles follow a 3-2-1 structure: three facts, two insights, one actionable.

## Sections

- [Home](/): Current dispatch, recent essays, diagnostic CTA.
- [Insights](/insights): Filterable archive of all essays by category.
- [The CS Vanguard](/vanguard): News, field reports, and the paid premium archive.
- [The Retention Protocol](/retention-protocol): Playbooks and frameworks for revenue retention.
- [The Outcome Forum](/outcome-forum): Community essays and debate.
- [The CS Codex](/codex): Reference material, definitions, and playbook library.
- [CSFactors](/csfactors): Operating cockpit for live account portfolios (members).
- [AI Readiness](/ai-readiness): CS Operating Maturity Diagnostic — 8 dimensions, 32 metrics, scoring CS orgs from Block to AI Native.
- [Job Board](/job-board): Curated CS job listings.
- [Benchmarks](/benchmarks): Quarterly NRR and Payback Period data drops.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free Briefing vs. Vanguard tiers.
- [Subscribe](/subscribe): Newsletter signup.
- [About](/about): Editorial mission and audience.
